melee-golden.name: fixed-step battle stream runs a symmetric melee battle, preserves the input, and emits sufficient validated display deltas

battle-repeat-enumeration.name: fixed-step battle stream repeats event/state/physics hashes and preserves combat under participant and revision enumeration changes

startup-order-independence.name: fixed-step battle stream resolves startup status/periodic effects before the first interval without dependence on actor order

unresolved-status-conflict.name: fixed-step battle stream does not invent a priority for conflicting accepted status definitions or retain partial costs

budget-retry.name: fixed-step battle stream rolls back a budget-exhausted interval and retries the same simulation hash with a larger attempt budget

last-interval-simultaneous-defeat.name: fixed-step battle stream resolves the last allowed interval, checks simultaneous defeat before timeout, and starts nothing at the end boundary

integrated-attack-occlusion.name: fixed-step battle stream uses attack occlusion independently from visibility in the integrated hitscan loop

time-limit-not-host-timeout.name: fixed-step battle stream completes all 6000 intervals with zero action speed and does not turn game time into a host timeout

projectile-golden.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions hits once per projectile at high speed and records spawn, clipped path, impact and removal

projectile-thin-wall.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions stops both fast shots at a 2mm transparent wall without applying body damage

projectile-relative-sweep.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions sweeps against the target motion through the interval rather than its final position

curve-budget.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions bounds parabolic chord error, enforces subdivision budgets, and preserves the path with a larger budget

homing-observation.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions limits homing turn and only uses delivered owner observations; lost visibility continues ballistically

explosion-occlusion.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions applies spherical body intersection, partial wall coverage and distance attenuation

projectile-pool-truncation.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions expires only after its last interval and truncates simultaneous spawns atomically when the pool is full

projectile-private-state.name: projectiles, curved sweeps and explosions does not leak private projectile state through a structural observation input

catalog-pillar-enumeration.name: data-composed 3D sample catalog routes a ground fighter around a pillar while a flying caster shoots from above, independent of enumeration

probe-open.name: reproduces the full 6000-step 'open' geometry fixture on both CI platforms

probe-dense.name: reproduces the full 6000-step 'dense' geometry fixture on both CI platforms

physics-repeat.name: 3D-01 physics feasibility repeats TS trajectories and Rapier snapshot bytes with stable construction order

physics-same-contact-time.name: 3D-01 physics feasibility stops both approaching bodies at the same contact time and permits separation

physics-wall-body-tie.name: 3D-01 physics feasibility blocks a non-piercing attack when wall and body contacts tie within the fixed tolerance

physics-fast-thin.name: 3D-01 physics feasibility sweeps fast projectiles against moving bodies and thin walls

physics-slid-chord.name: 3D-01 physics feasibility checks relative contact along the slid path, including a collision missed by its chord

fixed-trigonometry.name: deterministic numeric profile uses fixed trigonometry and a bounded turn without runtime sin/cos

numeric-encoding.name: deterministic numeric profile encodes binary64 in network byte order with explicit zero and non-finite rules

movement-golden.name: simultaneous fixed-step locomotion treats 20ms as a deterministic interval independent of input identity order

movement-reversed-enumeration.name: simultaneous fixed-step locomotion stops both actors symmetrically and gives the same result under reversed enumeration

navigation-enumeration.name: bounded body-aware support graphs uses direct travel first, then detours around a solid obstruction independently of node enumeration

perception-delay.name: legal observations and conditional policies delays observations by the declared reaction interval and snapshots positions before mutation

perception-flags.name: legal observations and conditional policies enforces range, field of view and vision flags independently of attack flags

perception-memory.name: legal observations and conditional policies uses last-seen memory without learning a hidden current position, then expires it

perception-priorities.name: legal observations and conditional policies honors declared conditional priorities, readiness and configured flight altitude

perception-projectile-enumeration.name: legal observations and conditional policies does not give equidistant projectile enumeration a steering priority

perception-observed-projectiles.name: legal observations and conditional policies only exposes observed enemy projectiles and evaluates bounded ASTs against self resources

attack-observed-range.name: action clocks and attack geometry checks range and forward orientation against the immutable observation, not a hidden live position

attack-thin-wall.name: action clocks and attack geometry stops an instantaneous thick shot at a thin transparent wall before the target

attack-muzzle-wall.name: action clocks and attack geometry blocks a muzzle offset across a wall even when the outgoing ray starts beyond it

attack-moving-target.name: action clocks and attack geometry detects a moving target crossing a thrust between endpoints and retains every body slide segment

terrain-transparent-wall.name: 3D static world lets vision cross a transparent wall while blocking bodies and attacks

terrain-muzzle-visibility.name: 3D static world distinguishes eye visibility from a blocked lower muzzle

effects-order-free-shield.name: simultaneous effects applies defense, resistance and a shared shield without allocating remainders by order

effects-simultaneous-lethal.name: simultaneous effects combines shields granted in the same interval and preserves simultaneous lethal effects

status-budget-retry.name: status lifetime and stacking reports status budget exhaustion and succeeds with larger attempt limits without changing definitions

status-unresolved.name: status lifetime and stacking reports conflicting accepted definitions as unresolved and leaves both inputs untouched

prepare-revision-set.name: immutable spatial manifest resolution pins all identities, resolves types, preserves the caller and normalizes only revision sets

canonical-ordered-arrays.name: canonicalizes keys without erasing ordered arrays and uses a stable UTF-8 SHA-256 contract

observed-ai-integration.name: common engine cognition and effects executes scoped reveal and experiences, with occlusion and fresh-match knowledge

observed-ai-noninterference.name: private delayed bounded cognition does not distinguish hidden enemy definitions with the same lawful visible appearance

observed-ai-probability.name: observed utility distributions prefers ordinary self extinguishing without making it compulsory, then favors a supported quick kill

observed-ai-dodge.name: common engine cognition and effects uses four equal flying escapes in actual streamed combat; movement and collisions decide the result

cross-os.name: cross OS corpus comparison compares each expected input and rejects missing, stale or changed evidence

fairness.name: bounded generated battle invariants exchanges actor IDs slots positions facings and owned random streams independently of hash equality

worker-corpus.name: runs the fixed corpus through one and multiple real Workers in reversed submission order

job-timeout.name: persistent Worker/API orchestration does not resurrect cancellation and records a timeout as failure, never as a game draw

job-recovery.name: persistent simulation job ownership recovers lease expiry across connections and fences stale or duplicate completion

job-properties.name: compares generated ownership transitions with real SQLite and fences stale notifications

property-resources.name: bounded generated battle invariants checks HP MP resistance and shared shield boundaries against integer arithmetic

property-status.name: bounded generated battle invariants generates status lifetimes with expiry before periodic damage

property-mutant.name: bounded generated battle invariants retains a minimized counterexample for an intentional assertion violation and succeeds after correction

load-counters.name: load evidence gate rejects each missing or over-budget counter instead of zero filling

load-missing.name: load evidence gate refuses stale SHAs, missing samples, profile drift and truncation

load-review.name: load evidence gate requires exact before and after review for changed costs and ceilings

load-pair.name: load evidence gate does not compare timings from unrelated runner sessions

baseline-missing.name: existing test adapter and coverage checks never passes missing or duplicate fixed execution entries

load-artifacts.name: requires raw load trials and commands even when the summary reports success

load-working-tree.name: load evidence gate keeps working-tree verification separate from committed evidence

load-transitions.name: load evidence gate requires review and independent boundaries for corpus profile or runtime transitions
